title: Prove P112 six-dimensional incidence floor and exclude two literal C5 callers
body:
Two literal historical C5 callers have total support budgets of 156 and 148. This package proves that eleven pieces spanning six P112 code dimensions need at least **164 support incidences**, excluding `5^10,7` and `5^9,6^2` with margins **8 and 16** over every characteristic-zero field. Their quotient dimension is five under the explicitly inherited second generalized-weight bound.

The new argument pairs generalized Hamming weights with root-matroid fibers and singleton/pair incidence. A common-zero correction raises the naive 152 floor to 158; pair incidence strengthens it to `164 + 4z`, where `z` coordinates vanish on the same six-dimensional code subspace. It permits arbitrary coefficients, cancellations and dependent pieces in the general lemma. Actual caller pieces retain their original independence hypotheses.

Evidence:

- Exact rational enumeration of all 4,900 rank-two and 85,680 rank-three root-spanned flats, with closure digests and attaining controls.
- Separate 23-pattern Gram certificate for the rank-three root cap of six lines.
- All 393 positive definite rank-four Gram patterns and 245,625 integral target vectors certify the pair-fiber cap of twelve; Bareiss and permutation-determinant implementations agree on the complete case digest.
- Both named rows pass the unchanged PR3154 filter. Registered optimized replay, meaningful boundary/actual-code/receipt-mutation controls, committed-source/history checks and read-only Git-free export replay pass.
- A separate agent audited scalar extension, common-zero counting, quotient binding and the pair-incidence inequality. This is assisted-team corroboration, not independent human or proof-kernel acceptance.

Reproduce: `python3.12 -I -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-six-dimensional-incidence`.

Credit Nick Petalas/PR3269 and PR3300 for the inherited 12/20/36 binary support capacities, DreamingOfClouds/PR3154 for the historical reduction, and the retained root-simplex, David Arias and joaqcoo lineage. Exact canonical-main inputs and predecessor pins are included. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.

The dominated `5^11` and `5^10,6` profiles also follow. This is not a claim that these were the only public residues, a first-exclusion claim, or a completed 174-row reconciliation. Full C5, constructive decoder/supplier admission, the multiplication theorem and a new kappa remain open. The selected frontier is unchanged. This focused package creates no dependency on the concurrent common30 or kappa investigations.
